subject: BlueHarbor portal activation + MSA redline and PO field checklist
messages:
From: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@blueharborpharma.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Tom Redd <tom.redd@blueharborpharma.com>, procurement@blueharborpharma.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Portal onboarding / MSA — kickoff and evidence checklist

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BlueHarbor is ready to start portal activation (Ariba) and we need to align on two quick things before we kick off with our ops team:

1) Legal: we've attached an MSA with a few redlines from our counsel (high level: data residency note, tighter indemnity carve-outs, and a shorter warranty period). Could you confirm who on Redwood legal will own the redline review and expected SLAs?

2) Ops: procurement wants a PO field mapping spreadsheet — they need to know whether Redwood supports PO line-level metadata (SKU mapping, cost center, GL class, tax jurisdiction) and whether we can provide a sample SFTP endpoint for test POs.

Timeline: they'd like portal provisioning and a signer path by 11/26 to avoid delaying year-end budget cycles. Is that feasible?

Attached: BlueHarbor_MSA_redline_20271115.docx (redline)

Best,
Julia Sullivan
Head of Procurement
BlueHarbor Pharmaceuticals

Hi Julia — great to hear. Thanks for sending the redline and the ask. Quick notes: 

- Legal owner: I'll loop in Kimberly from Legal for the MSA review (cc'd). Kimberly, can you confirm availability and a target turnaround?
- Ops owner: Marissa will own the portal activation and PO field mapping (cc'd). Marissa, can you prepare a PO field mapping template and confirm whether we can provide SFTP test credentials or whether BlueHarbor prefers API push (we support both)?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>
To: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@blueharborpharma.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodai.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Portal onboarding / MSA — kickoff and evidence checklist

Hi Julia — Kimberly from Legal here. Thanks for the redline. I reviewed BlueHarbor_MSA_redline_20271115.docx and did a classified pass; attaching a marked-up summary and an internal guidance sheet. High-level takeaways below, broken out for quicker procurement/ops decisions:

1) Data residency clause — we can offer a contractual commitment to process EU/US data in respective regions for customer-controlled datasets, but full residency for all telemetry (service logs/telemetry) is operationally constrained. If you require strict contractual residency for telemetry, we'll need Dedicated or Private deployment and a scope addendum.

2) Indemnity — BlueHarbor's requested broad indemnity for third-party claims tied to customer data is expansive. Proposed compromise: carve indemnity to direct damages from breach of Redwood's obligations; exclude consequential and punitive damages.

3) Warranty and liability cap — we can propose a 12-month warranty for code-level defects, not for model output quality. Liability cap tied to 12 months of fees is standard; we can engage commercial for exceptions.

4) Signature routing — we recommend DocuSign and can pre-fill signer paths once procurement confirms authorized signatories.

Action items I need from BlueHarbor:
- Confirm whether telemetry/residency is a hard requirement for initial activation or negotiable.
- Provide the authorized signer name(s) and email for DocuSign.

Attachments (to BlueHarbor): BlueHarbor_MSA_redline_20271117-legalnotes.docx (docx)
Attachments (internal): BH_MSA_negotiation_strategy_20271117.pdf (pdf)

If BlueHarbor confirms telemetry residency is negotiable, we can accept the MSA with the proposed indemnity carve and keep portal onboarding on the hosted flow. If they've mandated telemetry residency, ops will need to scope Dedicated.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Tom Redd <tom.redd@blueharborpharma.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@blueharborpharma.com>, procurement@blueharborpharma.com
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding / MSA — kickoff and evidence checklist

Kimberly, Jordan — thanks for the quick review. A few clarifications from IT/procurement after internal sync: 

- Telemetry: For now the telemetry residency ask is negotiable. Obligating full telemetry residency is not a blocker for initial activation — they can accept hosted telemetry with contractual controls and stricter retention settings. We'll treat Dedicated as a mid-year upgrade if needed.
- Signer: Julia Sullivan (julia.sullivan@blueharborpharma.com) and CFO Thomas Kearns (t.kearns@blueharborpharma.com) are the two authorized signers for this agreement.
- PO field mapping: attached is a short sample of BlueHarbor's PO extract. Please confirm the mapping we can accept back and whether Redwood can include the GL code and tax jurisdiction as custom PO header fields.

Attached: BH_PO_Field_Mapping_20271118.xlsx (xlsx)

Can you confirm by EOD Monday 11/22 if Redwood accepts the indemnity carve and the liability cap language so we can proceed to DocuSign routing? That will keep the timeline to provisioners for 11/26.

Tom Redd
IT Systems
BlueHarbor Pharmaceuticals
